text:
You are here: Home / Top stories / Apple, Inc. (AAPL) Needs China For A Huge 2019 Apple, Inc. (AAPL) Needs China For A Huge 2019 August 24, 2018
China has been one of the biggest concerns for Apple, Inc. (Nasdaq: AAPL) investors in 2018 due to the escalating international trade war. If AAPL stock is going to continue its march higher in fiscal 2019, analysts say China will play a critical role. GBH Insights head of technology research Daniel Ives says there are 350 million iPhones around the world that will be in need of an upgrade within the next 18 months.
